question: What did Tryambakāditya do after being created to continue the lineage?
premises: Tryambakāditya was created as a mind-born son.
He went to a cave named Tryambaka.
inference: Tryambakāditya went to the Tryambaka cave as part of his spiritual mission.
plain_english: He too, having gone properly to the cave named Tryambaka, thereafter—
